summary_en: DAIKEN executed a share buyback of up to 80,000 shares (1.46% of outstanding shares) for up to 67.92 million yen at the closing price of 849 yen per share via ToSTNeT-3 on October 21, 2026.
title_en: Notice on Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Purchase of Treasury Stock via Off-Hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On October 20, 2026, DAIKEN's board of directors authorized the execution of a treasury stock acquisition via off-hours trading. The company proceeded with the purchase on October 21, 2026, using ToSTNeT-3 at the prior day's closing price of 849 yen per share.

The buyback targeted up to 80,000 shares with a maximum purchase amount of 67.92 million yen. This represented 1.5% of outstanding shares (calculated from 80,000 shares divided by 5,483,389 outstanding shares excluding treasury stock as of August 31, 2026). The order was executed only during the designated trading window on October 21 at 8:45 a.m. and remained subject to market conditions, meaning the full amount might not have been purchased.

The company stated the rationale as implementing flexible capital policy in response to changes in the management environment. Results were to be disclosed immediately following the completion of the trading session.
